answer: This is a local teaching experiment tied to the lesson "Shipping: CI, Providers and SDK Upgrades," where a declared release gate was evaluated entirely offline against a locked build artifact. The checks performed included typechecking, an offline build verification, and an adapter smoke test — all of which passed — but no actual deployment occurred. It illustrates the structure of a local release gate (compile, run host scenarios, bind checks to an artifact, and require a live smoke test when policy demands one) without representing any real remote integration or deployed system.
